audit_scope: Independent Verification of Candidate Findings for Falah Restaurant POS C# Port

rejected_candidates.claimed_title: Authentication Middleware Non-API Path Bypass Perimeter Exposure
rejected_candidates.claimed_issue: Claimed that AuthenticationMiddleware.cs skips token validation for requests whose path does not start with '/api/', potentially allowing unauthenticated requests to bypass authentication and access application endpoints.
rejected_candidates.counterevidence_summary: In Falah.Server/Program.cs, all application domain and business API endpoints are routed exclusively under '/api/v1/'. The only non-API endpoint mapped in the entire application is '/health' at line 2251 (and Swagger UI conditionally in Development mode). The health check endpoint is explicitly designed and documented as an unauthenticated connectivity/liveness probe (verifying database connectivity via CanConnectAsync). No authenticated, administrative, or data-bearing endpoints exist outside the '/api/' prefix. Skipping authentication for non-API paths is intentional design and does not create any security perimeter bypass.

rejected_candidates.claimed_title: Payable Total Floor-At-Zero Clamping Obscures Financial Discrepancies
rejected_candidates.claimed_issue: Claimed that clamping payable total to Money.Zero in CheckoutRules.ComputePayableTotal when (cartTotal + deliveryFee - compAmount) is negative obscures financial discrepancies and hides discount or comp overflow in accounting.
rejected_candidates.counterevidence_summary: ComputePayableTotal computes customer-payable balance due at checkout. When an order is 100% comped, the customer payable total is zero; clamping at Money.Zero prevents drawer cash-in or POS payment processors from attempting to collect negative cash. Financial integrity and auditing are completely preserved across independent channels: 1) OrderEntity preserves raw SubtotalPiastres, DiscountPiastres, and CompPiastres in dedicated columns without distortion; 2) SalesRules aggregates manual discounts and comps directly from these audited entity fields; 3) PrintRules prints Subtotal, Discount, Comp, and Net Payable as distinct line items on receipts; 4) PricingRules.AssertCompAmount bounds comp amounts during order calculation (asserting comp <= orderValue and comp > 0). Clamping PayableTotal to Money.Zero is standard POS settlement logic and does not obscure any financial discrepancy.
